assets.scope: Standee batch 1 (17 ids). Second artwork used only for the upright standee layer at <=48px cells. Identity evidence: the shipped native sprite and the shipped flat token, both pinned below; the game was not launched for this round. Flat 128px token, its master and the manifest mapping are untouched.
assets.gate_reason: The shipped flat 128px cut-out is a near-square top-down token; at the 1.0-cell standee width cap it is width-bound and renders about one cell tall, reading as the flat token rather than an upright standee. A full-body upright standee is required for the standee layer only; the flat token, its master and the manifest mapping are unchanged.
assets.desc: A giant black-skinned humanoid covered in spikey scabrous deposits. Its face is featureless; its eyesockets, empty and hollow.

references.note: The shipped flat dremling token: copy its matte painted miniature finish, colours and value structure. Ignore its top-down camera and its physical disc entirely - the standee has no disc.
Native dremling sprite: identity cue only. Keep the same species, gear, colours and markings, converted to a true upright standing composition; it is not a pose or proportion specification.
The shipped drem token shares this black corrupted-humanoid body plan, so it is the token this one must stay clearly distinct from; do not copy its pose.

assets.render_evidence_note: No fixture run. Identity-render evidence is the pinned native sprite PNG and the shipped flat token PNG; the desc line in the pinned native NPC source is the appearance authority.

prompt_fields.subject: dremling: a giant black-skinned humanoid covered in jagged scabrous grey deposits and spikes, a faceless head with two empty hollow eyesockets, heavy clawed hands and hunched shoulders. Match the shipped token's coal-black skin and pale grey scab plating.
prompt_fields.contrast: Taller than wide: stand at full height with a heavy forward hunch, long arms held close to the body and claws turned inward. Because the skin is near-black, give the head, shoulders and claw edges a clear pale grey scab rim and a soft cool rim light so it still reads at 48px.
prompt_fields.composition: Full body, upright standing front three-quarter view, arms hanging with claws forward, feet planted, the featureless head at the top of the frame. Overall height to width about 1.8 to 1.
prompt_fields.palette: near-black charcoal skin, pale grey scabrous plates and spikes, cold blue-grey rim light, dark hollow eyesockets.

assets.desc: An enormous ogre, clad in a tattered set of robes with an officer's badge. She clutches a healer's staff, wrapped in casting plaster and scalpels for use as a massive spiked club.

references.note: The shipped flat healer-astelrid token: copy its matte painted miniature finish, colours and value structure. Ignore its top-down camera and its physical disc entirely - the standee has no disc.
Native healer-astelrid sprite: identity cue only. Keep the same species, gear, colours and markings, converted to a true upright standing composition; it is not a pose or proportion specification.
The shipped ogre-guard token shares this ogre body plan, so it is the token this one must stay clearly distinct from; do not copy its pose or its hammer.

assets.render_evidence_note: No fixture run. Identity-render evidence is the pinned native sprite PNG and the shipped flat token PNG; the desc line in the pinned native NPC source is the appearance authority.

prompt_fields.subject: Healer Astelrid: an enormous ogre woman in a tattered purple and grey robe with a tarnished officer's badge, her big hands clutching a long healer's staff wrapped in white casting plaster and ringed with scalpels, held like a spiked club. Match the shipped token's violet robe, dark hair and wrapped staff.
prompt_fields.contrast: Taller than wide: stand at full height with the wrapped staff held vertical or angled close to the body, not swung wide. The staff may rise above the head.
prompt_fields.composition: Full body, upright standing front three-quarter view, both hands on the wrapped staff, robe falling to the feet, the staff top allowed above the head. Overall height to width about 1.8 to 1.
prompt_fields.palette: violet and grey tattered robe, grey-blue ogre skin, white plaster-wrapped staff with steel scalpels, dark hair.
